text: Recently the Ministry of Transportation began a project to reconstruct the Avenue Road bridge over Highway 401. As part of the work, the number of lanes on the bridge overpass has been reduced from three lanes to a single lane in each direction. While this is a much needed project to completely rebuild an aging piece of infrastructure, there is a lot of concern and confusion in the local neighbourhoods due to ensuing traffic chaos as well as insufficient notification and consultation. Residents have complained that they did not receive any notification in advance of the project beginning; the work began suddenly and has resulted in an enormous increase in traffic congestion on Avenue Road and local roads; there is no signage up on the bridge detailing of nature of the work and the expected completion date and the local City Councillors in the area were not advised in advance of the…

City Council on May 22, 23 and 24, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council request the General Manager, Transportation Services to request the Ministry of Transportation to prepare a comprehensive construction notice to be sent out as soon as possible to be distributed in the Armour Heights neighbourhood in Ward 10 for the Avenue Road Bridge Replacement project. 2. City Council request the General Manager, Transportation Services to request the Ministry of Transportation to immediately install signage at the Avenue Road Bridge over Highway 401 and any surrounding streets where necessary to provide details on the project, contact information and information on lane closures and advise local Councillors whether Paid Duty officers are required on this site. 3.
